user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Each vehicle is one SPOT messenger. Enter the ID of the SPOT shared feed it reports to, and the feed password if the feed has one. Vehicles that share a feed are polled together.

vehicle.title: Choose the vehicle's tracker

reconfigure.title: Update feed password
reconfigure.description:
Feed ID: {feed_id}

Enter the current password for this shared SPOT feed, or leave it empty if the feed has none. The feed and messenger cannot be changed because they identify this vehicle's tracker and archived history.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the SPOT feed
error.feed_not_found: SPOT has no feed with this ID. Check the ID of your shared feed.
error.feed_rejected: SPOT rejected the request: {spot_error}. Check the feed password.
error.no_messenger: Choose or type a messenger ID

init.title: Vehicle settings

import_gpx.name: Import historical SPOT GPX
import_gpx.description: Import an Activity Report GPX and show added, duplicate, and skipped counts in a notification. Optionally returns detailed response data.

filename.name: GPX filename
filename.description: Relative path beneath /config, for example spot_exports/ActivityReport.gpx

feed_id.name: SPOT feed ID
feed_id.description: Optional: only import into vehicles on this SPOT feed.

entry_id.name: Integration entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional: the integration entry of the one vehicle to import into.

device_mapping.name: GPX track-to-device mapping
device_mapping.description: Mapping from GPX track names to messenger IDs, selecting the vehicle for each track.

feed_mapping.name: GPX track-to-feed mapping
feed_mapping.description: Optional mapping from GPX track names to SPOT feed IDs, for names shared by vehicles on different feeds.

import_sqlite.name: Import SPOT iOS database
import_sqlite.description: Import a SPOT iOS SQLite export and show added, duplicate, and skipped counts in a notification. Optionally returns detailed response data.

filename.name: Database filename
filename.description: Relative path beneath /config. The source is opened read-only; invalid coordinates are skipped.

feed_id.name: SPOT feed ID
feed_id.description: Optional: only import into vehicles on this SPOT feed.

entry_id.name: Integration entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional: the integration entry of the one vehicle to import into.

device_mapping.name: App device-to-messenger mapping
device_mapping.description: Map device names in the iOS database to messenger IDs, selecting the vehicle for each. App database IDs are separate from messenger IDs.

feed_mapping.name: App device-to-feed mapping
feed_mapping.description: Map device names in the iOS database to SPOT feed IDs, for names shared by vehicles on different feeds.

no_vehicle.message: This entry for SPOT feed {feed_id} has no messenger, because none had reported before the update that made each vehicle its own entry. Delete it and add the vehicle again.
